story.en: ...I heard it's going to rain. Where are you going without an umbrella.

story.text: '경기전' 안 가봤어요? 조선 태조 어진 모셔둔 곳인데. 마침 가는 길이니까 따라오든가.
story.reading: 'gyeong-gi-jeon' an ga-bwass-eo-yo? jo-seon tae-jo eo-jin mo-syeo-dun gos-in-de. ma-chim ga-neun gil-i-ni-kka tta-ra-o-deun-ga.
story.en: You haven't been to 'Gyeonggijeon'? It's where King Taejo's portrait is enshrined. I'm headed there anyway, so come along if you want.

story.text: 저는 '예보' 미리 확인하는 습관 있어요. 즉흥적으로 나왔다가 낭패 보기 싫어서.
story.reading: jeo-neun 'ye-bo' mi-ri hwag-in-ha-neun seup-gwan iss-eo-yo. jeuk-heung-jeog-eu-ro na-wass-da-ga nang-pae bo-gi silh-eo-seo.
story.en: I have a habit of checking the 'forecast' ahead of time. I hate stepping out on a whim and getting caught off guard.

story.text: '비' 온다고 했잖아요. 그래서 미리 챙겨온 거예요, 이거.
story.reading: 'bi' on-da-go haess-jan-a-yo. geu-rae-seo mi-ri chaeng-gyeo-on geo-ye-yo, i-geo.
story.en: I told you it would 'rain'. That's why I brought this ahead of time.

story.text: …이거 써요. 저는 하나 더 있으니까. '우산' 뺏는 거 아니에요.
story.reading: …i-geo sseo-yo. jeo-neun ha-na deo iss-eu-ni-kka. 'u-san' ppaes-neun geo a-ni-e-yo.
story.en: ...Use this. I have another one. I'm not taking your 'umbrella' away.

story.text: 이런 '습관', 웃기죠. 근데 덕분에 손님 안 젖었잖아요.
story.reading: i-reon 'seup-gwan', us-gi-jyo. geun-de deok-bun-e son-nim an jeoj-eoss-jan-a-yo.
story.en: This 'habit' is kind of funny, I know. But thanks to it, you didn't get soaked.
...Who said I was worried. It's just... you were on my mind, that's all.

words.example_en: Gyeonggijeon is a famous place in Jeonju.
I checked the weather forecast and brought an umbrella.
Preparing in advance is my habit.

sentences.en: I check the forecast before going to Gyeonggijeon.
I check the forecast and prepare in advance.
When it rains, I use an umbrella.
I got caught in the rain without an umbrella.
Thanks to this habit, I didn't get wet.
